description: Domain-authority history: the stored trend of dated authority snapshots for one project+domain, oldest first. FREE (no credits) — reads back snapshots already captured, no provider call. Empty until at least one snapshot exists: get_domain_overview auto-captures one whenever `domain` is the project's own domain, or call capture_domain_authority_snapshot directly for any domain (including a tracked competitor).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_domain_authority_history
